trans.sense: a ceremony where people try to communicate with the spirits

examples.text: [B]ut only too often séances degenerate into pure sorcery or necromancy, attracting all kinds of undeveloped and earth-bound entities.
examples.ref: 1936, Rollo Ahmed, The Black Art, London: Long, page 231:

glosses: A ceremony where people try to communicate with the spirits of dead people, usually led by a medium.

raw_glosses: (dated) The sitting of an assembly to discuss a matter.
